decisions.reason: As a prominently launched new product line close to the core software, it reflects visible commitment, likely meaningful development investment, and a strong fit with the firm's digital-practice direction.

Although less prominently marketed, it builds on the firm's existing training and customer-support capabilities, so management would tend to justify continuing it as part of the broader customer ecosystem.
This tool is closely tied to the firm's support function and connected-practice strategy, making it easy for management to view any weak traction as temporary and worth persisting with.
A dedicated analytics dashboard sits squarely in the firm's stated move toward more digital and efficiently managed practices and likely carries enough development commitment to sustain it.
A complete practice bundle is highly central to the established business, commercially visible, and easy for management to defend as a strategic anchor despite any mixed early results.
The portal is the most distant from the core offer and had only limited visible commitment, so escalation pressures are weaker and management is more likely to reallocate resources away from it.
